name: Fiachna mac Dáire

attributes.attribute: snagged a talking worm while fishing
the swineherd's enemy, the White Bull

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: While fishing at Cuailnge in northern Ulster, Fiachna mac Dáire snagged a worm that could speak. The worm made an odd prophecy. War would come over a bull from the region. The worm had reason to know. It was the reincarnated soul of a swineherd. That swineherd later became the great Brown Bull, Donn Cuailnge. Queen Medb of Connacht launched the Cattle Raid over that bull. A second worm had advised Medb to marry Ailill mac Máta. That worm was the swineherd's bitter enemy. It became the White Bull of Connacht, Finnbennach. The two bulls met in an epic final battle.

okr.objective: Fiachna mac Dáire caught a talking worm whose prophecy foretold the Cattle Raid over the bull Donn Cuailnge.
key_results: The talking worm was the reincarnated soul of a swineherd.
It became the great Brown Bull, Donn Cuailnge.
Queen Medb launched the Cattle Raid over that bull.
Its enemy became the White Bull Finnbennach, and the two bulls fought at the end.
